# openobserve_alert_templates (Data Source)

Lists the alert templates of an OpenObserve organization.

## Example Usage

```terraform
data "openobserve_alert_templates" "all" {}

output "editable_templates" {
  value = [for t in data.openobserve_alert_templates.all.templates : t.name if !t.is_prebuilt]
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Optional

- `org_id` (String) Organization identifier. Defaults to the provider's `org_id`.

### Read-Only

- `id` (String) Data source ID.
- `templates` (Attributes List) The templates found. (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--templates))

<a id="nestedatt--templates"></a>
### Nested Schema for `templates`

Read-Only:

- `body` (String) Message body.
- `is_default` (Boolean) Whether this is the default template.
- `is_prebuilt` (Boolean) Whether the template is system-managed.
- `name` (String) Template name.
- `title` (String) Email subject line.
- `type` (String) Channel the template renders for.
